He shall build a House in My Name, and he shall be to Me as a son, and I to him as a Father, and I shall prepare the throne of his kingdom forever.'
Now, my son, may Havayah be with you, and you shall prosper, and you shall build the House of Havayah your Elokim, as He spoke of you.
But may Havayah give you intelligence and understanding, and may He command you over Yisroel, and to keep the Law of Havayah your Elokim.
Then you will prosper if you observe to perform the statutes and the judgments that Havayah commanded Moshe over Yisroel; be strong and of good courage; do not fear and be not dismayed.

And behold, in my poverty, I prepared for the House of Havayah one hundred thousand talents of gold, a thousand thousand talents of silver, and of copper and iron without weight, for it was in abundance, and I prepared wood and stones, and you shall add to them.
And with you in abundance are workmen, hewers and workers in stone and wood, and every skillful person in every type of work.
Of gold, of silver, of copper, and of iron, there is no number. Arise and do, and may Havayah be with you."
And Dovid commanded all the princes of Yisroel to aid his son Shlomo.

"Is not Havayah your Elokim with you? He will give you peace round about, for He has delivered into my hands the inhabitants of the land, and the land has been conquered before Havayah and before His people.

Now put your hearts and your souls to seek Havayah your Elokim; arise and build the Sanctuary of Havayah Elokim to bring the Ark of the Covenant of Havayah and the holy vessels of Elokim to the House that is to be built in the name of Havayah."
Now Dovid was old and full of days, and he made his son Shlomo king over Yisroel.
And he gathered all the princes of Yisroel and the priests and the Leviim.
And the Leviim were counted from thirty years old and upward, and their number by their heads was thirty-eight thousand men.
Of these, to conduct at the service of the House of Havayah, were twenty-four thousand, and officers and judges were six thousand.
And four thousand gate sentries and four thousand who praised Havayah with the instruments that I made with which to praise.
And Dovid divided them into divisions [according to] the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kehath, and Merari.
Of the Gershonim; Ladan and Shimi.
The sons of Ladan; the chief was Yechiel, and Zetham, and Yoel, three.
The sons of Shimi; Shelomis and Haziel, and Charan, three; these were the heads of the fathers' [houses] of Ladan.
And the sons of Shimi; Yahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah; these are the sons of Shimi, four.
And Yahath was the chief, and Zizah was the second one, and Jeush and Beriah did not have many children; so they became a father's house of one appointment.
The sons of Kehath; Amram, Izhar, Chevron, and Uzziel, four.

The sons of Amram; Aharon and Moshe, and Aharon was separated, to be sanctified as most holy, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before Havayah, to serve Him, and to bless with His name to eternity.
But as for Moshe, the man of Elokim-his sons were to be called in the tribe of Levi.
The sons of Moshe; Gershom and Eliezer.
The sons of Gershom; Shebuel the chief.
And the sons of Eliezer were; Rechavyah the chief, and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rechavyah multiplied greatly.
The sons of Izhar; Shelomis the chief.
The sons of Chevron; Yeriyah the chief, Amaryah the second, Yahaziel the third, and Yekamam the fourth.
The sons of Uzziel; Michah the chief and Yishiyah the second.
The sons of Merari; Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Mahli; Elazar and Kish.
And Elazar died, and he had no sons but daughters, and the sons of Kish, their brethren, married them.
The sons of Mushi; Mahli and Eder, and Yeremos-three.

These are the sons of Levi to their fathers' houses, the leaders of the fathers' [houses] to their numbers, in the number of names according to their heads, who perform work for the service of the House of Havayah from twenty years old and upward.
For Dovid said, "Havayah Elokim of Yisroel has given peace to His people, and He dwells in Yerushalayim to eternity.
And also, the Leviim shall no longer have need to carry the Tabernacle and all its vessels for its service."
For in Dovid's final words, the sons of the Leviim were numbered from twenty years old and upwards.

For their station was alongside the sons of Aharon, for the service of the House of Havayah, over the courts, and over the chambers, and over the purity of all sacred things and the performance of the service of the House of Elokim.

And for the showbread, and for the fine flour for the meal offerings, and for the wafers of unleavened bread, and for the shallow pan, and for the flour boiled to softness, and for every liquid measure and solid measure.
And to stand every morning to give thanks and to praise Havayah, and so in the evening.
And for every offering up of burnt offerings to Havayah on Sabbaths, on New Moons, and on festivals in number, according to the ordinance concerning them, constantly before Havayah.
And they shall keep the watch of the Tent of Meeting and the watch of the Sanctuary, and the watch of the sons of Aharon their brethren for the service of the House of Havayah.
And of the sons of Aharon, their divisions: the sons of Aharon [were] Nadab, and Abihu, Elazar, and Ithamar.
And Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and they had no sons, and Elazar and Ithamar served as priests.
And Dovid divided them, and Tzadok was of the sons of Elazar, and Achimelech was of the sons of Ithamar, for their appointment in their work.

And the sons of Elazar were found to be more-according to [the count of] the heads of the people-than the sons of Ithamar, and thus they were divided; of the sons of Elazar there were sixteen heads of the fathers' houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers' houses, eight.
And they divided them by lots, these with those, because they were princes of the Sanctuary and princes of Elokim of the sons of Elazar and of the sons of Ithamar.

And Shemayah the son of Nethanel the scribe, of the Leviim, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Tzadok the priest, and Achimelech the son of Ebiathar, and the leaders of the fathers' [houses] of the priests and of the Leviim; one father's house established for Elazar and what was established for Ithamar remained established.
And the first lot came out to Yehoyariv, to Yedayah the second.
To Harim the third, to Seorim the fourth.
To Malkiyah the fifth, to Miamin the sixth.
To Hakkoz the seventh, to Aviyah the eighth.
To Yeshua the ninth, to Shechanyah the tenth.
To Eliashib the eleventh, to Yakim the twelfth.
To Huppah the thirteenth, to Yeshevav the fourteenth.
To Bilgah the fifteenth, to Immer the sixteenth.
To Hezir the seventeenth, to Happizzez the eighteenth.
To Pesachyah the nineteenth, to Yechezkel the twentieth.
To Yachin the twenty-first, to Gamul the twenty second.
To Delayah the twenty-third, to Maazyah the twenty fourth.
These are their appointment[s] to their service, to come to the House of Havayah according to their ordinance by the hand of Aharon their father, as Havayah Elokim of Yisroel had commanded him.
And of the remaining sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram: Shubael, of the sons of Shubael; Yechdeyah.
Of Rechavyah: of the sons of Rechavyah; the chief was Yishiyah.
Of the Yitzharim: Shelomos; of the sons of Shelomos; Yahath.
And the sons of Iryah: Amaryah the second, Yahaziel the third, Yekamam the fourth.
The sons of Uzziel, Michah; of the sons of Michah: Shamir.
The brother of Michah: Yishiyah; of the sons of Yishiyah: Zecharyah.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Yaazyah his son.
The sons of Merari: of Yaazyah his son, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
Of Mahli: Elazar, and he had no sons.
Of Kish: the sons of Kish; Yerahmeel.
And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Yerimos; these are the sons of the Leviim according to their fathers' houses.

And they too cast lots opposite their brethren, the sons of Aharon, before King Dovid, and Tzadok, and Achimelech, and heads of the fathers' [houses] of the priests and of the Leviim; Aboth the leader opposite his small brother.

Then Dovid and the generals of the army separated for the service of the sons of Asaf, Heiman, and Yedusun, who prophesied with harps, with lyres, and with cymbals, and the number of those men expert in their work, according to their service, was:
Of the sons of Asaf: Zaccur, and Yosef, and Nesanyah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaf through Asaf, who prophesied according to the direction of the king.

Of Yedusun the sons of Yedusun: Gedalyah, and Zeri, and Yeshayah, Chashavyah, and Matisyah-six, beside their father Yedusun with the harp, who prophesied with [songs of] thanksgiving and praise to Havayah.
Of Heiman: the sons of Heiman; Bukiyah, Matanyah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Yerimos, Chananyah, Chanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti Ezer, Yoshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.
All these were sons of Heiman, the king's seer, in words of Elokim to raise the horn, and Elokim gave Heiman fourteen sons and three daughters.
All these were alongside their father in song in the House of Havayah, with cymbals, psalteries and harps, for the service of the House of Elokim, alongside the king, Asaf, Yedusun, and Heiman.
And their number with their brethren, trained in song to Havayah; every expert-two hundred eighty-eight.
And they cast lots, a watch against [a watch], like the small one so the great one, scholar with pupil.
And the first lot of Asaf came out to Yosef, Gedalyah the second; he and his brethren and his sons, twelve.
The third: Zaccur; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The fourth to Izri: his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The fifth: Nesanyah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The sixth: Bikkuyah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The seventh: Isarelah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The eighth: Yeshayah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The ninth: Matanyah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The tenth: Shimi; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The eleventh: Azarel; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
The twelfth to Chashavyah: his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the thirteenth: Shubael; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the fourteenth: Matisyah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the fifteenth: to Yeremos; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the sixteenth: to Chananyah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the seventeenth: to Yoshbekashah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the eighteenth: to Chanani; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the nineteenth: to Millothi; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the twentieth: to Eliathah; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the twenty-first: to Hothir; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the twenty-second: to Giddalti; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the twenty third: to Mahazioth; his sons and his brethren, twelve.
To the twenty-fourth: to Romamti Ezer, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
Of the divisions of the gate sentries: of the Korchim; Meshelemyah the son of Kore of the sons of Asaf.
And the sons of Meshelemyah: Zecharyah the firstborn; Yediel the second, Zevadyah the third, Yasniel the fourth.
Eilam the fifth, Yehochanan the sixth, Eljehoeinai the seventh.
And the sons of Obed-Edom: Shemayah the firstborn, Yehozavad the second, Yoah the third, and Sachar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth.
Ammiel the sixth, Yissachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth, for Elokim had blessed him.
And to Shemayah his son were born sons who ruled through their father's house, for they were mighty warriors.
The sons of Shemayah: Othni, and Refael, and Obed, Elzavad, his brethren, mighty warriors, Elihu and Semachyah.
All these are of the sons of Obed-Edom; they and their sons and their brethren, valiant men with strength for service-sixty-two to Obed-Edom.
And the sons of Meshelemyah and brethren valiant men, eighteen.
And the sons of Hosah of the sons of Merari: Shimri the chief, because although he was not the firstborn, his father made him the chief.
Chilkiyah the second, Tevalyah the third, Zecharyah the fourth; all the sons and brethren of Hosah, thirteen.
To these were the divisions of the gate sentries according to the chiefs of the men, watches corresponding to their brethren, to serve in the House of Havayah.
And they cast lots, the small like the great, to their fathers' houses, for each gate.
And the lot to the east fell to Shelemyah, and Zecharyah his son, a prudent counselor, cast lots, and his lot came out to the north.
To Obed-Edom to the south, and to his sons the house of the Asuppim.
To Shupim and to Hosah to the west with the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway, a watch corresponding to a watch.
To the east, the Leviim were six; to the north four every day, to the south four every day, and for the Asuppim, two each.
Toward the outside, to the west; four to the highway, two toward the outside.
These are the divisions of the gate sentries of the sons of the Korchim and of the sons of Merari.
And the Leviim: Achiyah over the treasuries of the House of Elokim and to the treasuries of the hallowed things.
The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonim; to Ladan, the chiefs of the fathers' [houses]; to Ladan the Gershoni, Yechieli.
The sons of Yechieli: Zetham and Yoel his brother over the treasuries of the House of Havayah.
To the Amramim, to the Yitzharim, to the Chevronim, to the Uzielim.
And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moshe, was the ruler over the treasuries.
And his brethren of Eliezer: Rechavyah his son, and Yeshayah his son, and Yoram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomis his son.

That is Shelomos and his brethren [who] were over all the treasuries of the hallowed things that King Dovid and the chiefs of the fathers of the princes of the thousands and the hundreds and the generals of the army had hallowed.
From the wars and from the spoils they hallowed, to strengthen the House of Havayah.
And all that Shmuel the seer, and Shaul the son of Kish, and Avner the son of Ner, and Yoav the son of Zeruyah had hallowed; all that was hallowed was in the hands of Shelomis and his brethren.
Of the Yitzharim: Kenanyah and his sons to the outside work over Yisroel, of the officers and of the judges.

Of the Chevronim: Chashavyah and his brethren, valiant men-one thousand and seven hundred, over the appointment of Yisroel from the side of the Yarden to the west, to all the work of Havayah and to the service of the king.

Of the Chevronim: Iryah the chief of the Chevronim to his generations to the fathers, in the fortieth year of Dovid's reign they were enquired of, and there were found among them mighty warriors in Yazer-Gilad.

And his brethren, valiant men — were two thousand seven hundred, the chiefs of the fathers' [houses], and King Dovid appointed them over the Reuvenim and the Gadim and half the tribe of the Menasheh, for every matter of Elokim and matter of the king.

And the Children of Yisroel to their number: the chiefs of the fathers' [houses], and the princes of the thousands and the hundreds, and their officers who serve the king in every matter of the divisions, the one coming and the one leaving, month by month, for all the months of the year; one division was twenty-four thousand.
Over the first division for the first month was Yashavam the son of Zabdiel, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
Of the sons of Peretz, the chief of all the leaders of the hosts, for the first month.
And over the division of the second month was Dodai the Achochi and his division, Umikloth was the leader, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The leader of the third host for the third month was Benayahu the son of Yehoyada the priest, the chief, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
He was Benayahu the mightiest of the thirty, and over the thirty and [over] his division was Ammizabad his son.
The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Yoav, and Zevadyah his son after him, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The fifth, for the fifth month, the leader was Shamhuth the Zerachi, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoi, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The seventh for the seventh month was Helez the Paloni, of the sons of Efrayim, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Chushasi, of the Zerachim, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anatoti, of the Binyaminim, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The tenth, for the tenth month, was Mahari the Netofasi, of the Zerachim, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benayahu the Pirasoni, of the sons of Efrayim, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netofasi, of Osniel, and on his division were twenty-four thousand.
And over the tribes of Yisroel: the leader of the Reuvenim was Eliezer the son of Zichri, of the Shimonim was Shefatyah the son of Maacah.
Of Levi was Chashavyah the son of Kemuel; of Aharon was Tzadok.
Of Yehudah was Elihu, [one] of Dovid's brothers; of Yissachar was Omri the son of Michoel.
Of Zevulun was Yishmayah the son of Ovadyah; of Naftali was Yerimos the son of Azriel.
Of the sons of Efrayim was Hoshea the son of Azazyah; of half the tribe of Menasheh was Yoel the son of Pedayah.
Of half the tribe of Menasheh in Gilad was Iddo the son of Zecharyah; of Binyamin was Yaasiel the son of Avner.
Of Dan was Azarel the son of Yerocham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Yisroel.
Now Dovid did not take their count from twenty years old and below because Havayah had promised to multiply Yisroel like the stars of the heavens.
Yoav the son of Zeruyah commenced to count, but did not finish, and there was wrath upon Yisroel because of this, and the number did not come up to the number of the chronicles of King Dovid.
And over the treasuries of the king was Azmaveth the son of Adiel, and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the towers was Yehonasan the son of Uziyah.
And over those who do the work of the field for the work of the soil was Ezri the son of Chelub.
And over the vineyards was Shimi the Ramasi, and over what was in the vineyards to the storehouses of the wine was Zabdi the Shefami.
And over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that are in the lowland was Baal-Chanan the Gederi, and over the storehouses of the oil was Yoash.
And over the cattle that pasture in the Sharon was Shirtai the Sharoni, and over the cattle in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.
And over the camels was Obil the Ishmaeli, and over the she-donkeys was Yechdeyah the Meironosi.
And over the flocks was Yaziz the Hagari. All these were the officers over King Dovid's property.
And Yehonasan, Dovid's uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding and a scribe; and Yechiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons.
And Achitofel was the king's counselor, and Chushai the Arki was the king's companion.
And after Achitofel were Yehoyada the son of Benayahu and Ebiathar, and the general of the king's army was Yoav.

And Dovid assembled all the leaders of Yisroel, the leaders of the tribes, and the leaders of the divisions who serve the king, and the leaders of the thousands, and the leaders of the hundreds, and the officers over all the property and the livestock of the king and his sons, with the attendants and the mighty men, and to all the mighty warriors to Yerushalayim.

And King Dovid rose to his feet and said, "Hearken to me, my brethren and my people; as for me, it is with my heart to build a house of rest for the Ark of the Covenant of Havayah and for the footstool of our Elokim, and I prepared to build.
But Elokim said to me, 'You shall not build a house in My name, because you are a man of war, and you have shed blood.'

But Havayah Elokim of Yisroel chose me out of the entire house of my father to become king over Yisroel forever, for He chose Yehudah for a ruler and in Yehudah, my father's house, and among my father's sons, He desired me to make me reign over all Yisroel.
And of all my sons — for Havayah gave me many sons-He chose my son Shlomo to sit on the throne of the kingdom of Havayah over Yisroel.
And He said to me, 'Your son Shlomo, he shall build My House and My Courts, for I have chosen him to me as a son, and I shall be to him as a father.
And I shall establish his kingdom for eternity, if he strengthens himself to perform My commandments and My ordinances as of this day.'

And now, before the eyes of all Yisroel, the congregation of Havayah, and in the ears of our Elokim, observe and seek all the commandments of Havayah your Elokim, in order that you inherit the good land and bequeath it to your sons after you forever.

And you, my son Shlomo, know the Elokim of your father and worship Him with a whole heart and with an eager soul, for Havayah seeks all hearts, and He understands the thoughts of every creation; if you seek Him, He will be found to you, and if you forsake Him, He will abandon you forever.
See now, for Havayah has chosen you to build a house for the Sanctuary; be strong and do it."
And Dovid gave his son Shlomo the pattern of the porch, and its houses, and its treasuries, and its upper stories, and its inner chambers, and the House of the Ark cover.

And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit; of the courts of the House of Havayah, and of all its chambers round about, of the treasuries of the House of Elokim, and of the treasuries of the hallowed things.
And of the divisions of the priests and the Leviim, and of all the work of the service of the House of Havayah, and of all the vessels of the service of the House of Havayah.
Of gold, in weight for gold, for all the vessels of every service, [of silver] for all the vessels of silver by weight for all vessels of every kind of service.

And the weight of the golden candelabra and their lamps of gold, of the weight of each candelabrum and its lamps, and for the silver candelabra in weight for the candelabrum and its lamps, in the services of every candelabrum.
And the gold in weight for the tables of the showbread, for every table, and silver for the silver tables.
And the forks and the basins and the branches were pure gold, and for the basins of gold in weight for each basin, and for the basins of silver in weight for each basin.
And for the incense altar, refined gold in weight, and for the pattern of the chariot, the cherubim of gold, which spread out [their wings] and covered the Ark of the Covenant of Havayah.
All was in writing, from the hand of Havayah, which He gave me to understand, all the works of the pattern.

And Dovid said to Shlomo his son, "Be strong and of good courage and do; do not fear and be not dismayed, for Havayah Elokim, my Elokim, is with you. He will neither forsake you nor abandon you, until the completion of all the work of the service of the House of Havayah.

And behold the divisions of the priests and the Leviim for all the service of the House of Elokim, and with you in all the work for every volunteer with wisdom for every service, and the leaders and all the people for all your words."
Then King Dovid said to the entire assembly, "My son Shlomo, whom Elokim alone has chosen, is young and tender, and the work is great, for the palace is not for man, but for Havayah Elokim.

And with all my strength I prepared for the House of my Elokim, the gold for the [things of] gold, the silver for the [things of] silver, the copper for the [things of] copper, the iron for the [things of] iron, and the wood for the [things of] wood, onyx stones and filling stones, carbuncle stones and embroidery, and all precious stones and marble stones in large quantity.
And moreover, since I desired the House of my Elokim, I have a treasure of gold and silver; I gave [it] to the House of my Elokim in addition to all that I prepared for the sacred House.
Three thousand talents of gold of the gold of Ofir and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay the walls of the houses.
The gold for the gold, and the silver for the silver, and for all the work in the hands of the craftsmen, and whoever volunteers to consecrate himself today for Havayah.
And the leaders of the fathers' [houses], the leaders of the tribes of Yisroel, and the leaders of the thousands and the hundreds with the leaders of the work of the king gave willingly.

And they gave to the service of the House of Elokim; gold, five thousand talents, and ten thousand darics and ten thousand talents of silver, and copper, ten thousand and eight thousand talents, and iron, a hundred thousand talents.
And anyone with whom stones were found gave [them] to the treasury of the House of Havayah by the hand of Yechiel the Gershoni.
And the people rejoiced over their donation, for they wholeheartedly donated to Havayah, and King Dovid also rejoiced a great rejoicing.
And Dovid blessed Havayah before the eyes of the entire assembly, and Dovid said, "Blessed are You, Havayah, Elokim of Yisroel our Father, from everlasting to everlasting.

Yours, O Havayah, are the greatness, and the might, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty, for all that is in the heavens and on the Earth [is Yours]; Yours, Havayah, is the kingdom and [You are He] Who is exalted over everything as the Leader.
And wealth and honor are from before You, and You rule over all, and in Your hand is strength and might, and it is in Your hand to magnify and to strengthen all.
And now, our Elokim, we give thanks to You, and praise Your glorious Name.
Now who am I and who are my people that we should gather up strength to donate like this, for all is from You, and from Your hand we have given it to You.
For we are strangers before You, and inhabitants like all our forefathers; as a shadow are our days on the Earth, and there is no hope.
O Havayah, our Elokim, all this store that we have prepared to build for You a House for Your holy Name — it is from You, and all is Yours.

And I know, my Elokim, that You test the heart and You desire equity; I, with the sincerity of my heart, have willingly donated all these; and now I have seen with joy Your people, who are present here, offer willingly to You.
O Havayah, Elokim of Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yisroel, our forefathers, keep this forever, even the creation of the thoughts of the heart of Your people, and prepare their hearts to You.
And to Shlomo, my son, give a perfect heart to keep Your commandments, Your testimonies, and Your statutes, and to do all and to build the palace that I have prepared. "

And Dovid said to the entire assembly, "Now bless Havayah your Elokim," and the assembly blessed Havayah, the Elokim of their fathers, and they kneeled and prostrated themselves before Havayah and before the king.

And they slaughtered sacrifices to Havayah and they offered burnt-offerings to Havayah on the morrow of that day, a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, and their libations, and numerous sacrifices for all Yisroel.
And they ate and drank before Havayah on that day with great joy, and they crowned Shlomo the son of Dovid a second time, and they anointed [him] to Havayah as ruler and Tzadok as priest.
And Shlomo sat on the throne of Havayah as king instead of Dovid his father, and he prospered, and all Yisroel obeyed him.
And all the leaders and the mighty men and also all King Dovid's sons placed their hand under King Shlomo.
And Havayah made Shlomo exceedingly great before the eyes of all Yisroel, and He bestowed upon him such regal majesty as had never been upon any king before him over Yisroel.
And Dovid the son of Yishai reigned over all Yisroel.
And the days that he reigned over Yisroel were forty years; in Chevron he reigned seven years, and in Yerushalayim he reigned thirty-three.
And he died in a good old age, full of days, wealth, and honor, and his son Shlomo reigned in his stead.
And the words of King Dovid, the first and the last-behold they are written in the words of Shmuel the seer and in the words of Nasan the prophet and in the words of Gad the seer.
With all his kingdom and his might, and the times that passed over him, and over Yisroel, and over all the kingdoms of the lands.
